name: Jason
bio: Jason hosted Paul and Silas in Thessalonica; when unbelieving Jews stirred up a mob to seize the missionaries and could not find them, they dragged Jason and other believers before the city rulers instead, accusing them of harboring men who defied Caesar by proclaiming another king, Jesus. The rulers released Jason only after taking security from him (Acts 17:5-9). A Jason, described as a kinsman of Paul, later joined him in greeting the Roman church from Corinth; he may be the same man who had hosted Paul in Thessalonica (Romans 16:21).
